test_title: PYST 13: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

You can sleep here but this bed is __squalid__ and wet.
solution:
The correct answer is Clean.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Squalid refers to places which are extremely filthy and unpleasant, frequently due to a lack of funds.

 
 
• Example: *Prison is a very squalid place.*
 
 
 
• Clean refers to a place free of dirt, pollution, bacteria, and so on.
 
 
• Example:* Her room is extremely clean.*
 
 
 
• ​**Squalid** and Clean have different meanings. 

Therefore, the correct option is **Clean.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****

 
• **Disorderly **refers to something that is untidy and poorly organised.
 
• **Uncomfortable **means not feeling comfortable or pleasant, or failing to make you feel comfortable or pleasant.
 
• **Painful** refers to physical discomfort caused by an injury or illness.
